weights_source: Central Statistical Office (CSO), Consumer Price Index July 2026 (released 14 August 2026), Table 2 'CPI, annual and monthly changes for main groups' and Table 4 'CPI, annual and monthly changes for detailed groups', Weight column; weights from the 2016/17 Household Income and Expenditure Survey; the 12 divisions add up to 100.00. Published in COICOP 1999: 08 Communication -> 2018-08 (7.36); 1999-12 Miscellaneous (2.14) split with the published sub-weights: 12.5 Insurance 0.61 + 12.6 Financial services 0.10 -> 2018-12 = 0.71; 12.1 Personal care 1.12 + 12.7 Other services 0.31 -> 2018-13 = 1.43. Group weights are not entered: the extracted text of Table 4 was ambiguous for 04.5 (classes electricity 4.53, gas 1.41, liquid fuels 0.53, solid fuels 0.31).
